[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:388YE Summer]]
__NOTOC__
<quote by="Announced by Laughlan Vi Temeschwar, Master of Rings">To construct the Northern Way, a great work building a safe passage between the city of Apulian and the territory of Zenith. This is funded by the Crimson Reapers.
</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a [[great work]] in Apulian, Apulus, Spiral
* Announcement by the [[Master of Rings]]
* More information can be found in the '''[[My_friends_are_my_estate#Northern_Way|My friends are my estate]]''' wind of fortune
* This commission received the support of League citizens as it was announced by the Master of the Rings

==Date==
* Summer 388YE

==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 50 wains of white granite
* 30 wains of mithril
* 30 thrones in labour costs 
* Six months to construct

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_the_Northern_Way}}
==Outcome==
Once complete, the Northern Way will have the following effects:
* Raises the level of investment in [[Zenith]] by one, providing 36 rings for each [[business]] in the territory
* Removes the penalty to businesses in Spiral from the {{Black Plateau}}
* Enables the Crucible of Fate to boost the output of the [[Legacy]] and upgrade personal resources
